# Differential cases for the entity sections, load_box() and save_box() of
# G3's olympia/io.c, and the command parser of olympia/input.c that
# scan_command() uses, at G3 66b03fb09b541560268e66b553179d06ea30de80.
#
# tools/box-compat/run.sh feeds this file to a C driver built from the
# pinned sources and records its output in box-c-output.txt; TestBoxMatchesC
# feeds it to the Go port and requires the same output.
#
# Each "section NAME" line starts a section. Every section runs in a fresh
# process (a fresh world, after glob_init()) in a fresh, empty directory, so
# a section may end in a crash, and the files it writes are its own. run.sh
# adds "exit STATUS" after each section. stderr goes to the same place as
# stdout, in order.
#
# One operation per line; a line that starts with '#' is a comment, and
# blank lines are skipped. N, K, SK, P and V are integers, read with
# strtol(s, NULL, 0) and stored in a C int. TEXT is the rest of the line
# after one space, with \xHH and \\ escapes; with no space it is empty.
# NAME and WHAT are one word. Strings print with bytes outside ' '..'~',
# and '\', as \xHH, and NULL prints as NULL.
#
#   alloc N K SK        alloc_box(N, K, SK)
#   pretty P            pretty_data_files = P
#   libdir TEXT         libdir = TEXT
#   put NAME TEXT       append TEXT to file NAME
#   putl NAME TEXT      append TEXT and a newline to file NAME
#   readfile NAME       readfile(NAME), and its result
#   advance             line = readlin()
#   line                print line
#   load N              load_box(N), then print line
#   loadall             load_box(atoi(line)) while line is a box number, as
#                       read_boxes() does; a line that is not one prints
#                       "stop" and ends it (read_boxes() would skip it)
#   save N              save_box(stdout, N), then box N's temp if it has a
#                       box
#   saveall             save_box(stdout, N) for every N that has a box
#   cmd N               print p_command(N): cmd, fuzzy, conditional, who,
#                       use_skill, line, parsed_line and parse
#   parse TEXT          oly_parse_cmd() of TEXT into the driver's one
#                       struct command, which keeps its state from one parse
#                       to the next; prints the result, fuzzy_find, TEXT as
#                       oly_parse_cmd() left it, and the command
#   find TEXT           find_command(TEXT) and fuzzy_find
#   p WHAT N            p_WHAT(N): char, magic, loc, subloc, item,
#                       item_magic, player, skill, gate, misc, disp or
#                       command
#   poke WHAT N V       set a field of box N that io.c does not read, to
#                       test zero_check(): loc_next (entity_loc.next),
#                       prov_dest_empty (allocate an empty prov_dest),
#                       mage_worked, one_turn_use, opium_double, cmd
#                       (command.cmd) or where (loc_info.where)
#
# Kinds: 1 player, 2 char, 3 loc, 4 item, 5 skill, 6 gate, 7 road,
# 9 ship, 11 storm. Subkinds: 3 plain, 14 city, 30 galley, 49 pl_regular.

section oly_parse_cmd
parse study 600
parse   STUDY 600
parse & move north
parse ?attack 1002
parse &
parse ?
parse
parse # only a comment
parse    
parse move\x09north\x09 
parse move "  spaced out  " 'single  quoted' x
parse say "hello # world"
parse say 'it''s'
parse say "ends in a quote"
parse say 'ends in a quote'
parse say "unterminated
parse say 'unterminated
parse "" move
parse '' move
parse "move" north
parse 'move' north
parse move\x01\x1fnorth\x7f
parse move \xe1\x80\x9f\xa0 n
parse stduy 1
parse studdy 1
parse sudy 1
parse stucy 1
parse stu 1
parse xyzzy 1
parse "a""b"
parse \x09\x09move\x09
parse move #
parse #move
parse move"x"y
parse move a"b c"d
parse name "Joe #1"
parse name 'Joe #1'
parse name Joe's keep # note
parse name "Bob # x
parse name 'Bob # x
parse name Dee # "hi"
parse name Dee # 'hi'
parse name "a"#b
parse name "a"'#'b
parse name "a""#b"
parse name a"#b"
parse name a'#b'
parse name x\x09"#tab" # gone
parse name "x" y'z # gone
parse "#quoted command" 1
parse '#' 1
parse # "not a quote"
parse name "
parse name '
parse name "#
parse name ""#
parse name '' # gone
